Verdict

Reviewed 20 Oct 2026 · next 18 Apr 2027

Strong runner-up and the better choice when inputs may be cyclic or contain Map/Set. Best type inference in the field, zero deps, active, published with SLSA provenance. Falls short only on release ergonomics: it authenticates with a long-lived NPM_TOKEN rather than OIDC trusted publishing.

Current Reviewed version 8.0.2 Requirement: Deep merge of nested configuration objects

Reasoning

  1. Handles circular references and merges Map/Set contents, which @fastify/deepmerge does not.
  2. Most precise inferred types: optionality preserved and conflicting keys resolve to the right-hand type.
  3. SLSA v1 provenance from .github/workflows/release.yml; lint, unit, type and type-test jobs must pass before the release job runs.
  4. Active: 8.0.2 released 2026-08-21 with 0 open issues and 0 open PRs.
  5. Zero runtime dependencies.

Caveats

  • Release job uses an NPM_TOKEN secret rather than OIDC trusted publishing; a leaked token is a real, if manageable, risk.
  • 280 KB installed because it ships ESM, CJS and source maps; about 8x the Fastify package.
  • Slower at ~196k ops/s on our workload.
  • Single maintainer (RebeccaStevens); bus factor of one.

Decision context

Approved

@fastify/deepmerge is the primary choice for Deep merge of nested configuration objects. This package is classified as Adopted.

Adopt @fastify/deepmerge as the primary implementation: it is the only candidate that combines OIDC trusted publishing, SLSA provenance, zero runtime dependencies, bundled types, active maintenance and immunity to CVE-2026-93753. deepmerge-ts is approved as the fallback for cyclic inputs or Map/Set merging, at the cost of a long-lived NPM_TOKEN in its release pipeline. deepmerge is dropped because the vulnerability has no upstream fix and is invisible to npm audit. ts-deepmerge, merge-deep, lodash.merge, @corex/deepmerge, deep-extend and the CVE-fork packages are rejected; defu, merge-anything and @75lb/deep-merge remain on hold and are not approved for this requirement.
